content.what_it_is: MATLAB bathymetry smoothing utility (FUNWAVE-TVD tools/filter/matlab). Loads depth.txt from a user-set folder (fdir @L3, load @L4), applies a 3x3 moving-average convolution K=0.11111*ones(3) @L8 via conv2(dep,K,'same') @L9, overwrites only interior points excluding an edge border of 5 cells (edge @L6, in-place slice assignment @L11), and saves ASCII new_depth.txt @L13. Same filter core as test_bathy/read_tiff.m but for an existing FUNWAVE text depth grid.
entities: script (no functions); variables: fdir @L3, dep @L4 (reassigned interior @L11), edge @L6, K @L8, tmp @L9

verbatim_spans.text: edge=5; % set edge points you dont want filter

unresolved: K sums to 0.99999 rather than 1 (0.11111 vs 1/9) — repeated application slightly damps depth; intent unresolved (same kernel as read_tiff.m L25)
single filter pass only; no loop count or convergence criterion — whether users should iterate is not stated in this file
